verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer versioned APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of any API, versioning scheme, or deprecation policy. The probes show only bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on the front door and the ORION filing portal, which says nothing affirmative about an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
